title: Pancreatic Cancer or Acidity? Warning Signs, Blood Tests and the Diagnostic Pathway
description: How to distinguish common indigestion from symptoms that warrant pancreatic evaluation: back pain, weight loss, jaundice, new diabetes, CA 19-9 limits, CT and EUS.

faq.question: Can acidity be an early sign of pancreatic cancer?
faq.answer: Indigestion can occur in people with pancreatic cancer, but acidity is very common and usually has other causes. Persistent or changing symptoms with weight loss, jaundice or back pain need assessment.

faq.question: Can pancreatic cancer cause back pain without jaundice?
faq.answer: Yes. Some patients have upper-abdominal or back pain without jaundice; this is especially possible when the bile duct is not obstructed.

faq.question: Does a normal CA 19-9 rule out pancreatic cancer?
faq.answer: No. CA 19-9 is neither a screening nor a rule-out test. Some patients with pancreatic cancer have normal CA 19-9.

faq.question: Can amylase and lipase identify pancreatic cancer?
faq.answer: No. They are used mainly when pancreatitis is suspected and cannot diagnose or exclude pancreatic malignancy.

faq.question: Which scan is best when cancer is suspected?
faq.answer: A contrast-enhanced pancreas-protocol multiphasic CT is a central imaging test; MRI/MRCP or EUS may be added based on clinical findings.

faq.question: Should all people with diabetes have CA 19-9 testing?
faq.answer: No. Diabetes is common. The combination of new diabetes with unexplained weight loss or other red flags warrants clinical risk assessment, not automatic CA 19-9 screening.

faq.question: Is pancreatic cancer curable?
faq.answer: Some early, operable cases may be treated with curative intent using surgery and systemic treatment. Outcomes depend on stage, tumour biology and specialist assessment.

faq.question: Can blood tests find bile duct obstruction?
faq.answer: Liver biochemistry can suggest cholestasis but imaging is required to identify the cause and location.

faq.question: Where can I get a CA 19-9 test in Bengaluru?
faq.answer: QXL Diagnostics lists CA 19-9 in its oncology and gastroenterology services. It should be ordered and interpreted with appropriate specialist advice.

faq.question: When is jaundice an emergency?
faq.answer: Yellow eyes with fever, chills, abdominal pain, confusion or severe illness needs emergency care because bile-duct infection can become life threatening.
